items.title: Daily Water Minute · The $2,920 math nobody talks about
items.preview:
Words I like;
"If you can't measure it, you can't improve it." Peter Drucker said that about business, but it works for your wallet too.
Here's the math most people never do: one 24-pack of bottled water runs about $6 these days. If your family goes through two packs a week (pretty normal for a household of four), that's $624 a year. Over five years? $3,120. Over ten? $6,240.
And that's conservative. Add in the gas stations, the vending machines, the convenience store runs when you're out, and the real number climbs fast.
Nobody wakes up and says "I want to spend three grand on plastic bottles." It just happens a case at a time.
For folks who already have a ClearWave system, you know this. You did the math before you called us. You're drinking straight from the tap now, and that $50-a-month habit is gone.
For everyone else: I'm not saying bottled water is evil. I'm saying it's expensive, and most people genuinely don't realize how expensive until they add it up.
There's a better way. It starts with knowing what's actually in your water.
Hit reply and I'll send you our free water assessment.
As promised, value in under a minute.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
